title: Pitch Deck
purpose: Communicate a business or project opportunity in a short, coherent sequence. The deck is a summary, not a substitute for the underlying plan or diligence.

slides.title: Title
slides.instruction: Company/project, one-line proposition, date, presenter and contact.

slides.title: Problem
slides.instruction: One clearly evidenced customer problem; quantify only where supported.

slides.title: Customer and Use Case
slides.instruction: Who experiences the problem, who uses, who pays and who approves.

slides.title: Solution
slides.instruction: Show product/service and user workflow. Use real product/simulation images with fidelity labels.

slides.title: Why Now
slides.instruction: Technical, regulatory, economic or market timing with sources.

slides.title: Market
slides.instruction: Segment and sizing logic; avoid unsupported giant TAM claims.

slides.title: Product and Technology
slides.instruction: Architecture, maturity, roadmap, IP and defensibility.

slides.title: Validation / Traction
slides.instruction: Separate revenue, contracts, pilots, LOIs, user tests, lab tests and simulation.

slides.title: Business Model
slides.instruction: Pricing, revenue streams, channels and economics.

slides.title: Competition
slides.instruction: Alternatives and differentiation on decision-relevant dimensions.

slides.title: Go-to-Market
slides.instruction: Sales motion, partnerships, procurement and adoption plan.

slides.title: Roadmap
slides.instruction: Milestones, work packages, validation and regulatory gates.

slides.title: Team
slides.instruction: Relevant verified capabilities and missing hires.

slides.title: Financials and Use of Funds
slides.instruction: Capital ask, runway, milestone-linked spend and scenario summary.

slides.title: Appendix
slides.instruction: Detailed metrics, assumptions, technical architecture, financials and sources.
